app.title: Lorewarden Player
app.tagline: Join your game master's session to see handouts, hints and images.

join.name: Your name
join.nameHint: Your character's or your own name, so your game master knows who you are.
join.codeHint: Scan the QR code in your game master's app, or type the code shown below it.
join.wrongCode: This code is not valid (any more). Scan the QR code again or ask your game master for the current code.
join.heading: Join the table

table.waiting: Waiting for your game master to open live mode.
table.empty: Nothing revealed yet. Handouts, images and hints from your game master appear here.

initiative.heading: Your initiative?
initiative.hint: Roll initiative in your character tool and enter the result.

signUp.heading: Enter your character
signUp.intro: Your game master is collecting the characters of “{party}”. Enter yours; you can change it here later on this phone.
signUp.closed: The sign-up is closed. Ask your game master to open it again.
signUp.offline: Lorewarden cannot be reached. Check the connection and reload the page.
signUp.name: Character name
signUp.playerHint: First name or nickname, so your game master knows who plays whom.
signUp.notesHint: What you enjoy at the table, hooks from your background, things you'd rather avoid.
signUp.saved: Saved. Your game master sees your character now.
